sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
3. Learned counsels for the private parties jointly submit that, the dispute between the parties has been amicably settled.

They submit that, the marriage between the accused No.1-husband and respondent No.2-wife has been dissolved by a decree of divorce by mutual consent in F.C.O.P.No.199/2024 passed by the Court of Family Judge at NC: 2025:KHC:4862 Kadapa in Andhra Pradesh State.

entities.text: Court of Family Judge at NC: 2025:KHC:4862 Kadapa
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The parties at the time of settling their dispute based on which a mutual consent decree for divorce was passed
, have agreed to close the criminal case pending in C.C.No.626/2023.
Accordingly, they pray to allow the petition.
4. The parties have filed application under Section 320(2) read with Section 482 of Cr.P.C., before the Court and in paragraph Nos.5, 6 and 7 of the application, it is stated as follows:

"5. It is submitted that, in the meantime, the petitioner and respondent No.2 have jointly filed a petition for seeking a divorce by mutual consent, and the said petition was registered as F.C.O.P.No.199/2024 on the file of the Hon'ble Family Court-cum-VI Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh.

entities.text: Family Court-cum-VI Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Their marriage, dated 17.08.2022, solemnized at Tyagaraja Kalyana Mandapam, Proddatur, was dissolved as per the Judgment and Decree dated 04.12.2024 passed by the Hon'ble Family Court-cum-VI Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh.

entities.text: Family Court-cum-VI Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 6. It is submitted that, due to irreconcilable differences and incompatibility of temperaments, the petitioner and respondent No.2 have been living separately.
The efforts made by elders, friends, and well- NC: 2025:KHC:4862 wishers to resolve the differences between the parties did not yield any results.
There is absolutely no chance of reunion between them.

Hence, the petitioner herein and respondent No.2 have decided to get the marriage between themselves dissolved by a decree of divorced.
7.

It is submitted that respondent No.2 has voluntarily agreed to cooperate in closing C.C.No.626/2023, arising out of Crime No.15/2023 of the Mysore Women Police Station, for the offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 323 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, and Sections 3, 4, and 6 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, which is pending on the file of the Additional Civil Judge (Sr. Dn.) and CJM, Hunsur, Mysore District, registered against the petitioner Sri. Mopuru Indravadan Reddi vs State Of Karnataka on 3 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126793370/
4 herein and his mother and brother."

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. The dispute in the present case is within the family members and the said dispute is now settled and as a result of settlement, the marriage between the accused No.1 and respondent No.2 is already dissolved and the parties have decided to live separately.
They have also decided to put an end to all the pending cases between them.
The alleged offences in the present case are compoundable in nature.

Considering the aforesaid aspects of the matter, I am of the opinion that, the prayer made in this petition for quashing the entire proceedings based on the settlement NC: 2025:KHC:4862 between the parties needs to be allowed.

Accordingly, the following order:
ORDER (i) The criminal petitions are allowed;
(ii) The entire criminal proceedings registered in Crime No.15/2023 by the Mysuru Women Police Station, Mysuru, for the offences punishable under Section 498A, 323 read with Section 34 of IPC, and Sections 3, 4 and 6 of the Dowry Prohibition Act,
1961, pending on the file of Principal Civil Judge (Sr. Dn.) and CJM, Hunsur, Mysuru district, is quashed as against accused Nos.1 to 3/petitioners in these petitions.

Sd/-
